An '''inquiry''' was put into the sabotaging of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Anya Karu]]'', downed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives prior to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. However, this inquiry turned out to be just for show as the Galactic Empire soon demoted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aron Harcourt]], the commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the now downed [[Warship/Legends|warship]], to a desk job on a [[Harcourt's outpost|distant outpost]].
